I want something for everyday use, good quality, and I care about value for money.
Everyday pieces that last and feel good are very much our thing. I can help you narrow this down and suggest a small edit that works hard for your wardrobe and budget.
A good approach for value and quality
Build on versatile foundations:
Women: easy cotton or jersey dresses, straight or slim jeans, chinos, breathable tees and blouses, and a lightweight knit you can layer.
Men: chinos and jeans, polos or Oxford shirts, quality tees, and a fine-gauge knit for layering.
Prioritise fabric: natural fibres (cotton, linen, wool) and blends that feel soft but durable offer great price-per-wear. On each product page, open the “Fabric & care” section under the “Add to bag” button to check fibre content and care.
Choose easy care: machine-washable pieces, colours that mix-and-match, and timeless cuts will give you the most wear.
Get the fit right: use the size guide on each product page and take quick at-home measurements. For women, measure:
Bust: under your arms, across the fullest part
Waist: your natural waistline
Hips: around the fullest part of your bottom at the top of your leg
Match these to the chart on the item to pick your size.
Quality you can count on

I'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?
Absolutely. We can keep things stylish, hard‑wearing and good value by focusing on versatile pieces and the right fabrics. Here is a simple, budget‑friendly approach for everyday wear.
How to get the most value
Choose mix‑and‑match basics: neutral tees, jeans or chinos, a breathable shirt or blouse, and a lightweight knit. These work across seasons and maximise cost‑per‑wear.
Prioritise fabric: cotton, linen and wool (or blends) tend to be durable and comfortable. On each product page, open the Fabric & care section under the Add to bag button to check fibre content and care.
Pick easy care: machine‑washable pieces and colours that slot into your existing wardrobe help you wear items more often.
Everyday capsule ideas
Women:
2 cotton or jersey tees
Straight or slim jeans, or chinos
A jersey or ponte dress for desk‑to‑weekend
A lightweight cotton or merino knit for layering
Men:
Chinos and straight‑leg jeans
2 quality cotton tees or a polo
An Oxford shirt
A fine‑gauge knit for layering
Offers and sale
If you are browsing sale pieces, please note that sale items are excluded from further offers unless we have a special promotion running. You can check current exclusions on our offer exclusions page.
Built‑in peace of mind
Our 365‑day quality guarantee means that after the standard 30‑day return period (14 days for sale items), you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards for up to one year from when your order arrived. If an item is faulty and you return it within 6 months of receipt, we will refund you. Between 6 and 12 months, we will credit your account for the amount paid.

Your usual size and preferred fit (relaxed or tailored)
